why: Reproduced in 2 episodes. (a) Withheld tool_use (kestrel's 02:29Z prompt; transcript last record = the prompt): Home showed 'Deploy.sh dry run · kestrel · 15s→45s' as RUNNING with ▶ ✓ ◎ only, then removed the row 120.2 s after the transcript mtime while the registry still said waiting(permission prompt) (827 s) and the pane showed 'Do you want to proceed?'. (b) Fresh episode (rearm 02:50:24Z; this time Claude Code wrote the tool_use): the row flipped to running 'kestrel · 0s' 0.9 s after the registry flip, with ▶ ◎ and no Approve, and turned stuck+Approve only after 90.8 s. So 'never' holds for withheld episodes (driver 2/2, mine 1/1); written episodes get Approve ~91 s late against a ≤3 s target. Phase comes only from transcript silence: the registry's status/waitingFor (set within ~2 s) is never read (SESS_DIR is used only by locateSession, agents.js:314).

beacon held its AskUserQuestion (registry waiting(input needed) since 02:13:42Z, pane 'Enter to select', transcript last record = the prompt) through my whole 16-min session and never got a row: no question, no options, no Reply (shots A01–C06). Same withheld-record path as r1-S4-01 (running for ≤120 s after the last write, then parked; observed on kestrel). Separately, when the tool_use IS written, vibepet's ask for each of the 14 AskUserQuestion records in beacon's transcript evaluates to just 'AskUserQuestion' (toolAsk reads command/file_path/pattern/url/description, never questions/options), and the only action on a stalled row is Approve = Enter on the highlighted option. Approve's send-to probe on beacon: {ok:false, couldn't find its tab} (92–104 ms). Not a duplicate of r1-S4-01: the question/options gap remains after detection is fixed.

Reply 'yes' ×3 on kestrel's needs row: 'Couldn't send: couldn't find its tab' 164–258 ms after Enter, 0 new transcript lines, registry stayed idle. Approve on kestrel's stuck row ×2: 'Couldn't approve: couldn't find its tab' (117–143 ms), kestrel still waiting(permission prompt), 0 new lines. IPC probe send-to(null) kestrel/beacon: 4/4 the same. Process chain: claude → /bin/bash → /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux (ppid 1) → launchd, so hostApp() finds no .app and send-to refuses; there is no tmux send-keys path (no 'tmux' in main.js, agents.js or app.js).

7/7 row-title jumps on live tmux sessions (vibepet idle ×3, atlas busy ×3, kestrel with its permission dialog up ×1) returned {ok:false} in 96–141 ms (median 123). The frontmost app was unchanged each time, and each wrote 'cd ~/.vibepet-ultra/fleet/<member> && claude --resume <sid>' to the (recorded) clipboard: a second claude on a session that is live in its pane. The jump path has no tmux code at all, and hostApp walks only claude's own ancestors (bash → tmux server → launchd), so an attached tmux client can never be found or switched. Not re-run with a Terminal tmux client attached (that opens a window on the user's screen); the code makes that outcome deterministic.

Jump-failure bubble 6/6 and 'goal hit … +15xp' bubble 4/4: the bubble (rect 252,601 156×25) lies under the open panel, and the element on top at its centre was #chatInput (inside #chat) every time. Nothing in #now or #msgs said 'couldn't'. Shot A04 shows the bubble only as ghost text behind the chat input. The per-row note jumpTo() stores is never drawn: noteFor() has no callers, and jumpTo re-renders only the hover roster, which is hidden while Home is open. Level-up not re-observed (xp stopped at 135 < 160), but it uses the same element and CSS.

With kestrel's reply box open, I clicked into the chat bar and typed 'what is atlas doing' at 370 ms/char. The chat bar ended with 'w' and the reply box with 'hat is atlas doing': focus moved into the reply box at the first redraw (284 ms in). Each tick re-renders Home, the 'don't wipe a reply mid-typing' guard covers only inputs inside #now, and the render focuses the reply input.

(a) 3.3 s presses on ◎ spanning a redraw: 0/2 took effect; 120 ms presses between redraws: 2/2 took effect. (b) 8 Shift+Tabs put focus on the row's ◎; at the first redraw (2973 ms) document.activeElement became BODY. (c) A selection in the ask line was cleared at the first redraw (2054 ms). Home's #now innerHTML is rebuilt on every 3 s tick even when nothing changed.

A drag across kestrel's ask line selected 'hould dry-run output be stored in lo' and fired 1 ipc:jump → {ok:false}, plus 1 clipboard write of 'cd … && claude --resume <sid>' that would replace what the user meant to copy. The row click handler jumps on any click that isn't on a button or form; it never checks for a selection or a drag.

Before ✓: ▶@544 ✓@576 ◎@608; after ✓: ▶@576 ◎@608. A second click on ✓'s old spot 300 ms and 400 ms later opened Theater 2/2 (ipc:theater recorded, a second window). ✓ is removed once the goal is done, and the buttons sit in a right-aligned auto grid column, so ▶ slides into ✓'s slot.

After ✓ the button disappears and there is no undo. '/goal ' (reset) brings back the same auto goal, not done. 3 reset+✓ cycles wrote 3 goal_done rows for 'Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run…'. Today read 'Goals set: 2 · hit: 5' and xp went 0→75 (+15 each). Auto goals write no goal_set, and today() counts every goal_done row.

Measured on my shot B01: the ask 'Should dry-run output be stored in logs for audit purposes?' has strongest text pixel (249,219,149) on (246,245,239), 1.23:1; the title is 15.10:1 and the label 4.82:1. The stuck row's 'Bash: ./deploy.sh --dry-run' uses the same colour (C03). .na is #ffd98a and the light-theme block never overrides it. This instance rendered its light theme (renderer prefers-color-scheme: light).

The stuck row renders 'Approve ▶ ✓ ◎' (C06) and the needs row 'Reply ▶ ✓ ◎' (B01). ✓ and ◎ have no text and no aria-label; their meaning is only in title tooltips ('Mark goal done', 'Set goal'). ✓ next to Approve reads as accept, and a mis-press can't be undone (r1-S4-10).

The behaviour reproduces: ▶ opens Theater at 0:00 / 3:37, playing, chapter 1 of 28, which is the first prompt 6.4 h back. But that is what the button says ('Replay this session'), and the latest turn is one click away: one click at the scrubber's right end went to 3:43 / 3:44, with the question beat ('28 · Ask me one short yes/no…') right beside it (C07). The ask itself is already on the row. One extra click for context doesn't block a 5–15-session user; opening at the block would be an S5 enhancement.

Over 16 min (3814 samples at 250 ms), existing rows moved under a static pointer 40 times, by up to 136 px. Examples: kestrel 217→144 when atlas's row appeared (02:48:32); ember/atlas 196→269 and 251→324 when delta's ready row was inserted above them (02:58:09). kestrel and atlas swapped places between 02:42:36 and 02:43:05 when atlas's clock restarted. 'atlas · 0s' shows on every tick: unstick() flips stalled→working, so since resets each scan, and rows of the same rank sort newest-since first. There is no hover freeze, and Approve fires at once with no confirmation. Correction: Reply's box does name the session ('Reply to Deploy.sh dry run…').
kestrel's real permission dialog offers '3. No' and Esc, but its stuck row offered only Approve, ▶, (✓) and ◎ (C03, C06). No row state, roster or command offers deny, No or Esc.
Running rows (atlas busy in build.sh; A02, C06) offer only ▶ ✓ ◎. There is no interrupt or Esc anywhere; the command bar's /stop stops localhost ports, not sessions.
Ready rows (vibepet 'done 1m ago' in A02; ember 'done 2m ago' in C06) offer ▶ ✓ ◎ or ▶ ◎ only. Reply exists only for phase 'waiting', and classify assigns that only when the last text ends with '?'.
kestrel's dialog offers '2. Yes, and don't ask again for: ./deploy.sh *'. Its stuck row offers a single Approve (Enter on the highlighted option) and nothing else (C03, C06).

No row has a diff or changed-files action (A02, B01, C06). The per-turn receipt (files touched, +/−, check verdict) is computed in agents.js receipt() and sent in the snapshot, but its renderer rcLine() has no callers, so it never appears.

Every action is per row. At 02:59, with 4 rows listed (kestrel stuck, delta and ember ready, atlas running), there was no multi-select and no dismiss. Finished rows can't be acknowledged; they vanish 5 min after the turn (vibepet's ready row disappeared at 02:45:56.7, 5 min after its 02:40:56 end_turn).

The renderer handles only Escape. Reaching a row button took 8 Shift+Tabs from the chat bar, and that focus fell to BODY at the next redraw (2973 ms). The global jump key is the S7 surface, is off in tests, and jump fails on tmux anyway.

◎ on kestrel's auto goal ('Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run with the Bash tool.') filled the bar with '/goal ' (empty). After a typed goal, ◎ filled '/goal Critic goal one'. The prefill drops auto goals by design of that expression.
